script_text: Stop, Aquarius — Uranus is forming a tense square to Jupiter in your 4th House of Home, destabilizing emotions you've been suppressing. As your ruling planet, Uranus deepens every transit flowing through your chart — this square creates real friction around emotional safety and your air sign need for freedom. This is uncomfortable but necessary growth. In love, Venus is sextile your 7th House of Partnerships, opening a doorway for a connection that feels freeing and deeply understood — singles should welcome someone who challenges your independence without controlling you. For career, Saturn conjunct your Midheaven activates the 10th House of Public Status, meaning bold professional decisions this week shape your reputation for months ahead. The unexpected gift arriving is a communication or writing opportunity under Mercury this weekend, but the warning is this: protect your emotional boundaries tonight, because family demands will try to silently drain your energy. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
